name: Samarth Kumar Pal
title: Full-Stack Engineer, Co-founder & CTO
tagline: I engineer scalable digital systems. React on the front, Node and MongoDB in the middle, AWS underneath.
statement: I'm a full-stack engineer and the co-founder & CTO of DaemonHive Technologies. I turn messy business problems into fast, reliable software, from the first Figma frame to the last Nginx config.
bio: I co-founded DaemonHive Technologies and lead its engineering: a team building enterprise-grade software and cloud systems for SaaS, marketplaces, e-commerce, real-estate and community platforms.
My day moves between architecture reviews, writing the hard parts of the codebase, and keeping production calm: EC2, Nginx, PM2 and Cloudflare are as much my tools as React and Express.
Before DaemonHive I built products at Joahquin Technologies, including ZillionDines. College gave me C, C++, Java and C#; production taught me JavaScript end to end.
summary: Full-stack engineer, co-founder and CTO of DaemonHive Technologies. I design, build and run production web platforms end to end: React front-ends, Node.js/Express APIs, MongoDB data layers and the AWS, Nginx and Cloudflare infrastructure underneath. I've shipped SaaS, marketplace, e-commerce, real-estate investment and community products, and I care about small bundles, readable code and on-time delivery.
